name: Danganronpa: Greenlit
source:
16 students find themselves trapped inside of a luxury resort hotel, under the guise of an affluent academy's initiation ceremony. They soon find out that they are here to participate in a broadcasted killing game; The only way to escape? By killing another student and getting away with it.

[From [url=https://employee472.itch.io/greenlit]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
16名学生发现自己被困在一家豪华度假酒店内，假装是一所富裕的学院的入会仪式。他们很快发现自己来这里是为了参加一场直播的杀人游戏；唯一的逃脱方法？杀死另一名学生并逃脱惩罚。

[来自[url=https://employee472.itch.io/greenlit]itch.io[/url]]
